name: Pepper Chicken Fettucini
description: A colorful and flavorful chicken fettucini dish with sweet peppers, mushrooms, and Parmesan cheese.
recipeIngredient: 2 sweet red peppers, cut in strips

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a pan. Add chicken, peppers, onion, mushrooms, and seasoning. Stir-fry over medium heat until chicken is cooked through.
Add hot cooked fettucini noodles and toss.
Sprinkle with Parmesan and toss. Serve hot.

_similar.name: Parmesan Chicken
_similar.description: A crispy Parmesan-crusted chicken dish baked with spaghetti sauce and mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix Parmesan cheese with bread crumbs and set aside.
Mix eggs, salt, and pepper.
Dip boneless chicken breasts in egg mixture, then coat with bread crumb mixture.
Arrange coated chicken breasts in a baking dish.
Cover with tinfoil and bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.
Pour spaghetti sauce over the chicken and continue baking.
Before serving, sprinkle grated mozzarella cheese on top and bake for an additional 10 minutes until browned.

_similar.keywords: Parmesan chicken, breaded chicken, Italian-American cuisine

_similar.name: Stir-Fry Beef
_similar.description: A quick and flavorful beef stir-fry with vegetables and a savory sauce, served over cooked rice.
recipeIngredient: 2 lb boneless beef sirloin, cut into pieces
1 large green pepper, cut into strips

recipeInstructions.text: Heat vegetable oil in a frying pan.
Add beef and stir-fry until cooked through. Set aside.
Add peppers and onion to the pan and stir-fry until tender.
Stir in the mixture of tomato soup, soya sauce, orange juice, and vinegar. Cook until heated through.
Return beef to the pan and heat through, stirring occasionally.
Serve the beef mixture over cooked rice.

_similar.name: Pasta Tie Bow and Beef
_similar.description: A hearty pasta dish with sautéed beef, mushrooms, and red peppers, topped with Parmesan cheese.
recipeIngredient: ¾ lb (340 g) sirloin steak, sliced into thin strips
1 red pepper, cut into ¾ inch squares

recipeInstructions.text: Cook pasta in boiling water with 1 tsp cooking oil and salt for about 12 minutes. Drain and keep warm.
Heat wok on medium-high. Add 1 Tbsp cooking oil and stir-fry beef strips until desired doneness. Transfer to bowl.
Add another 1 Tbsp cooking oil to the wok. Stir-fry mushrooms, red pepper, and crushed chilies for 2 to 3 minutes until tender.
Add beef back into the wok and heat through. Stir in Parmesan cheese.
Spread cooked pasta on a plate and spoon the beef mixture over top. Sprinkle with additional Parmesan cheese.

_similar.name: Chicken-Pineapple Stir-Fry
_similar.description: A quick and flavorful stir-fry made with chicken breast, pineapple, and vegetables, served over hot rice.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine chopped onion, diced celery, green pepper strips, and pineapple chunks in a bowl.
In another bowl, mix together cornstarch, reserved pineapple juice, cinnamon, and soya sauce.
In a skillet over high heat, add margarine and cook chicken strips for 3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the onion mixture to the skillet and continue cooking for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the cornstarch mixture to the skillet, stir well, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and cook until the sauce is clear and thickened.
Serve the stir-fry over hot rice.

_similar.keywords: chicken stir-fry, pineapple chicken, quick dinner

_similar.name: Lemon Chicken With Thyme
_similar.description: A flavorful chicken dish made with lemon juice, thyme, and a light flour coating, served with lemon wedges and parsley.
recipeIngredient: Lemon halves and chopped parsley for garnish (optional)

recipeInstructions.text: In a plastic bag, combine flour, salt, and pepper. Add chicken and shake to coat lightly.
In a large skillet, warm oil over medium heat. Brown chicken about 5 minutes each side. Transfer to a plate.
Coarsely chop the onion. Add margarine to the skillet and stir until softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
Stir in reserved flour and combine. Add chicken broth, lemon juice, and thyme. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Return chicken to skillet, reduce heat to medium-low, and cover. Cook until chicken is tender, about 5 minutes.
Serve with lemon wedges and a sprinkling of parsley, if desired.
